_about: Miyu's own talent tree (Companions.tree), the same shape as Sera's in combat.json's character: groups left to right by level, each with its core skill in the Core row (ranks to 5, more at 3 and 5), Offensive above and Supportive below; Sera's Life & Body row at the bottom (lifeAndBody). book: the talent's first rank comes with that book (Companions.give_book) and can't be bought. lockedBy: a chronicle event; till it's happened the talent can't be learnt at any level (locks: what's said of it). fromBook: an older save where the Water Spell Book taught its spells at once: each spell learnt from it -> the talent it becomes, given at rank 1 for nothing (fromLevel: only from that level, else a point back). Glacial Spikes and Ice Pillar have no spell behind them yet (their icons only): to be made later.
name: Miyu

locks.miyu_advanced_ice: Miyu is unable to learn these advanced spells yet. Maybe someone could help her learn.
locks.book:WaterTome: Miyu learns this from the Water Spell Book: give it to her first.

talents.name: Ice Shard
talents.description: A fast shard of ice flung at a monster, bursting on the first one in its way and frostbiting it. The Water Spell Book teaches it; each rank after the first makes it hit harder.

talents.name: Twin Shard
talents.description: Ice Shard flies as two shards, the second just after the first.

talents.name: Frost Bite
talents.description: Her ice bites deeper: frostbite eats at what it's on harder.

talents.name: Keen Shard
talents.description: Sharper shards: Ice Shard hits harder.

talents.name: Quick Chant
talents.description: Her spells come quicker.

talents.name: Deep Spring
talents.description: More mana, and it comes back sooner.

talents.name: Healing Circle
talents.description: Water wells up round her: for some seconds everyone on her side standing in it is mended a little each moment. It goes where she goes. Each rank after the first heals more.

talents.name: Cold Edge
talents.description: Monsters inside her Healing Circle are chilled and slowed.

talents.name: Gentle Water
talents.description: Healing Circle mends more.

talents.name: Long Tide
talents.description: Healing Circle lasts longer.

talents.name: Wide Pool
talents.description: Healing Circle reaches farther.

talents.name: Frost Armor
talents.description: A shell of ice on everyone on her side near her (Sera, her companions and herself), soaking up blows. Each bursts when it breaks, hurting and frostbiting the monsters round it. Each rank after the first makes the shells stronger.

talents.name: Shatter
talents.description: Frost Armor bursts harder.

talents.name: Biting Shards
talents.description: Frost Armor's burst leaves a harder frostbite.

talents.name: Thick Ice
talents.description: Frost Armor holds more.

talents.name: Lasting Frost
talents.description: Frost Armor lasts longer.

talents.name: Ice Blast
talents.description: Ice bursts up out of the ground where she aims, a blast of spikes hurting and frostbiting everything there. Each rank after the first makes it hit harder.

talents.name: Frozen Ground
talents.description: Ice Blast leaves the ground frozen there a few seconds: a harder frostbite on whatever stands on it.

talents.name: Cold Snap
talents.description: Now and then her ice freezes what it hits solid for a moment: it can't move or strike. Each freeze soon after another is shorter, and after a few it shakes them off a while.

talents.name: Wide Blast
talents.description: Ice Blast covers more ground.

talents.name: Quick Freeze
talents.description: Ice Blast is ready again sooner.

talents.name: Blizzard
talents.description: Advanced ice magic. Shards of ice fall from the sky over an area for a few seconds, each shattering where it lands and hurting what's round it. Each rank after the first makes them hit harder.

talents.name: Glacial Spikes
talents.description: Advanced ice magic. A line of great ice spikes bursts up along the ground towards where she aims.

talents.name: Ice Pillar
talents.description: Advanced ice magic. A pillar of ice rises where she aims, blocking the way and chilling everything near it.

talents.name: Storm of Shards
talents.description: More shards fall in a Blizzard.

talents.name: Rime
talents.description: Every shard of a Blizzard frostbites what it hits.

talents.name: Long Storm
talents.description: Blizzard lasts longer.

talents.name: Wide Storm
talents.description: Blizzard covers more ground.
